method: HSV blue segmentation with connected-component shape filtering
scope: Separated blue workpieces in the original conveyor inspection scene. RGB is used only for localization. Defect classification uses frozen V28 grayscale processing. Touching or occluded objects require further validation.
coordinate_convention: Original decoded image pixels; xyxy right and bottom exclusive. Center is the axis-aligned box center, not a calibrated physical or grasp coordinate.
development: Localization checked on42 original training-split photos before the remaining originals. Padding follows existing crop context; grayscale->bilinear224 reproduces the archived training-image preparation. No defect weights or threshold fitted.
